in_hebrew.name: Gaither
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gaither הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English word 'geathe', which means 'ploughman' or 'farmer'. This name has strong associations with agriculture, hard work, and the land.
